final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e."aCL IgG") AS patient_igg_avg, AVG(e.ANA) AS patient_ana_avg FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_avgs AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_igg_avg) AS avg_igg, AVG(patient_ana_avg) AS avg_ana FROM patient_avgs GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_igg AS average_acl_igg, avg_ana AS average_ana, avg_ana / AVG(avg_ana) OVER () AS ana_ratio FROM sex_avgs
